description: This file implements the Wayland compositor interface, including functions for creating and managing surfaces and regions, and binding the compositor to a display.

methods.name: region_add
methods.description: Adds a rectangle to a region.

methods.name: region_subtract
methods.description: Subtracts a rectangle from a region.

methods.name: surface_attach
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to a surface.

methods.name: surface_damage
methods.description: Marks a region of the surface as damaged.

methods.name: surface_frame
methods.description: Handles frame callback for a surface.

methods.name: surface_set_opaque_region
methods.description: Sets the opaque region of a surface.

methods.name: surface_set_input_region
methods.description: Sets the input region of a surface.

methods.name: surface_set_buffer_transform
methods.description: Sets the buffer transform for a surface.

methods.name: surface_set_buffer_scale
methods.description: Sets the buffer scale for a surface.

methods.name: surface_damage_buffer
methods.description: Damages a buffer region of a surface.

methods.name: bind_compositor
methods.description: Binds the compositor interface to a client.

methods.name: BindCompositorInterface
methods.description: Binds the Wayland compositor interface to the display.
